newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EMERSON MISSING AGAIN - BUT WITH PERMISSION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EMERSON MISSING AGAIN - BUT WITH PERMISSION.

text.p: Brazilian midfielder Emerson will again be missing from the Middlesbrough side for the premier league match with Leicester on Tuesday - but this time the club say he has permission.

Emerson, who has twice gone absent without leave in the last three weeks, was allowed to travel home last Friday - he was suspended for Saturday's match at Aston Villa - with the aim of returning with his wife Andrea to thrash out the couple's problems in settling in northeast England.

Though a report circulated that he has gone without leave for a third time, manager Bryan Robson said: "We sent Emerson back on Friday to Brazil to collect his wife so we can have a meeting to try and make everyone happy.
"We want to make her contented. He has got a few problems but we are trying to resolve them. He is not for sale and we want to keep him happy and for his family to be happy.
"He has been playing well for us. But it is better to get everything resolved rather than let it drag on."
When asked if Emerson would play in Saturday's game at Leeds, Robson would only say: "We have not looked that far ahead yet."
Emerson previously arrived back at Middlesbrough 72 hours later from a Brazilian holiday and was then fined two weeks wages after his late return from a holiday in Portugal.
